mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_file (storage_key, public_url, user_id, purpose, expire_time) VALUES (#{storageKey}, #{publicUrl}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_key, public_url, user_id, purpose, expire_time FROM image_file WHERE public_url = #{url} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, storage_key, public_url, user_id, purpose, expire_time FROM image_file WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.id FROM image_file f WHERE f.expire_time <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_profile p WHERE p.avatar_url = f.public_url OR p.background_image_url = f.public_url) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog b WHERE b.cover_url = f.public_url) ORDER BY f.id LIMIT 200
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_profile WHERE avatar_url = #{url} OR background_image_url = #{url}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog WHERE cover_url = #{url})
